text:
Anya: Heads-up — seeing a spike in TLS handshake failures for proxy->backend in eu-west-1 starting ~07:10 UTC. Error surfaces as TLS alert 40 (handshake_failure). Any RBAC or KMS changes this morning?

Jordan: I pulled the proxy logs. Lots of `"error: KMS Decrypt denied"` entries for svc-proxy@prod. We started seeing this right after infra changes around 06:55.

Leo: Quick sample from KMS audit (truncated):
```
{ "protoPayload": { "authenticationInfo": {"principalEmail": "svc-proxy@prod"}, "status": {"code": 7, "message": "Permission denied"}, "request": {"name": "projects/xx/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/mtls-proxy-key"} }
}
```

Randall: That was me — I merged a keystore RBAC tighten PR (#842) to remove broad decrypt for some service accounts. I didn't realize svc-proxy still needed Decrypt on that key. Sorry.

SRE-Bot: deploy-bot: rollback started for infra/keystore-policy (deploy id d-8291).

Anya: For immediate mitigation, can we enable proxy local ephemeral cert fallback so traffic keeps flowing while rollback completes? Config flag: `--mtls-fallback=ephemeral`.

Jordan: Applying ephemeral fallback to proxy config and restarting pods now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/proxy -n prod` — rolling done for proxy-abc-{1..3}. Monitoring.

Leo: After restart, handshake failures dropped from ~4.8% -> 0.2% in the last 5m. Ephemeral fallback worked as expected, confirms decrypt path was the root.

security-oncall: Good catch. We need a quick blameless postmortem and follow-up:
- add a canary test for KMS decrypt on the keystore change PRs
- add an audit dashboard that alerts on `KMS Decrypt denied` spikes
- update RBAC change checklist to include impact analysis for keystore consumers

Randall: I'll open a revert/pr-scope-fix and include a canary step. Also will add a comment to the RBAC runbook about explicit keystore consumers.

Anya: Action owners: Randall = revert + scoped PR (ETA 1h), Leo = dashboard query + alert (ETA 3h), Jordan = CV test harness to run decrypt smoke before merge (ETA EOD), security-oncall = create postmortem ticket and link logs. :+1:

SRE-Bot: incident-bot: created ticket SEC-2026-18 (keystore-decrypt-rollback) and assigned to eng-security.

Jordan: Quick note for the runbook — audit query we used: `resource.type="kms_crypto_key" AND protoPayload.status.code=7 AND timestamp>"2026-03-22T06:50:00Z"` — saved it to shared queries.

Leo: For the long term, consider adding a lightweight pre-merge CI job that, given a policy diff, simulates principal->key Decrypt checks using a test key. That would've caught this.

Anya: Thanks all. Moving this to follow-up channel after rollback completes. Will paste final logs & timeline to the ticket.

Randall: Sorry for the outage, will be more careful and add the gating step. :bow:
